note: Young roles use natural adult performers. Do not request or create voices of minors, child-like voices, or clones of real people.

rosa.name: Rosa
rosa.appearance: Seven-year-old girl with pigtails, a friendly expressive face and a pink dress.
rosa.direction: Bright, curious and affectionate; lighter conversational delivery instead of a polished narrator.
rosa.description: A female adult voice performer in her early twenties, with a naturally light clear soprano speaking register. Bright, curious, friendly and affectionate; an open smiling sound and lively conversational rhythm. Gentle British English, clearly pronounced words, expressive small reactions and an unhurried pace. A natural adult performance for a fictional storybook character. Clean dry studio speech, no music or sound effects.

theo.name: Theo
theo.appearance: Small curly-haired boy in overalls; cheerful train-loving twin.
theo.direction: Light tenor, eager and playful; avoid a deep relaxed presenter voice.
theo.description: A male adult voice performer in his early twenties, with a naturally light high-tenor speaking register. Eager, playful and enthusiastic, with clear bright vowels and quick little changes of expression. Gentle British English; an easy conversational smile and clear unhurried words. A natural adult performance for a fictional storybook character. Avoid bass resonance, radio-presenter formality or shouting. Clean dry studio speech, no music or sound effects.

ada.name: Ada
ada.appearance: Small girl with hair puffs and orange overalls; confident twin.
ada.direction: Lively and decisive, with crisp playful emphasis; distinct from Rosa.
ada.description: A female adult voice performer in her early twenties, with a naturally clear upper mezzo-soprano register. Lively, decisive, sunny and spirited, with crisp playful emphasis and a confident smile. Gentle British English, expressive conversational rhythm, clear words and measured pace. A natural adult performance for a fictional storybook character. Never shrill, stern or sales-like. Clean dry studio speech, no music or sound effects.

pip.name: Pip
pip.appearance: Very small blond boy in a yellow jumper.
pip.direction: Light, soft, cheerful male performance; replace the mature female narrator.
pip.description: A male adult voice performer in his early twenties, with a naturally high light tenor speaking register and soft rounded vowels. Gentle, cheerful and slightly bashful, with a friendly smile and warm understated amusement. British English, a soft conversational voice and short clear unhurried phrases. A natural adult performance for a fictional storybook character. No booming chest resonance, corporate narration or forced rasp. Clean dry studio speech, no music or sound effects.

mateo.name: Mateo
mateo.appearance: Small curly-haired boy in green clothes; Rosa’s little brother.
mateo.direction: Light, mischievous and giggly; avoid the confident social-media presenter tone.
mateo.description: A male adult voice performer in his early twenties, with a naturally light forward high-tenor voice and a smiling, slightly nasal resonance. Mischievous, playful and warmly amused, with tiny natural chuckles and lively short phrases. British English, clear words and easy conversational pacing. A natural adult performance for a fictional storybook character. Never a deep announcer or brash sales presenter. Clean dry studio speech, no music or sound effects.

odette.name: Young Odette
odette.appearance: Young apprentice with goggles, a long braid and green work clothes.
odette.direction: Bright, earnest and curious; lighter than Nana and the former mature educator.
odette.description: A female adult voice performer in her early twenties, with a naturally light lyrical soprano voice. Bright, earnest, thoughtful and curious, with a warm sincere smile and gentle confidence. British English; clear words, a natural conversational rhythm and an unhurried pace. A natural adult performance for a fictional storybook character. Avoid mature school-lecturer formality, breathless excitement and a husky grandmother tone. Clean dry studio speech, no music or sound effects.

marigold.name: Captain Marigold
marigold.appearance: Older silver-haired woman in a navy captain’s coat and cap.
marigold.direction: Older female, steady and reassuring, with a little weathered warmth.
marigold.description: An older woman in her late sixties, a retired harbour captain and lighthouse keeper. British English with a warm gently weathered lower female speaking register, a little natural rasp and a reassuring smile. Steady, practical, kind and quietly authoritative; she cares deeply about bringing everyone safely home. Clear consonants, measured conversational pacing, never harsh or intimidating. Clean dry studio speech, no music or effects.

pockets.name: Professor Pockets
pockets.appearance: White-haired older man with round glasses, top hat and many pockets.
pockets.direction: Older male, whimsical and animated; gentle rather than booming.
pockets.description: An elderly British man in his seventies, an eccentric kind fairground inventor with a light warm tenor voice. Whimsical, delighted and animated, with a gently papery age texture, curious rising intonation and a little amused chuckle. Clear words and measured conversational pacing; welcoming and playful, never booming or threatening. A natural fictional storybook performance. Clean dry studio speech, no music or effects.

odum.name: Mrs. Odum
odum.appearance: Older woman with silver braids, spectacles and a straw gardening hat.
odum.direction: Older female, practical and warm, with calm matter-of-fact delivery.
odum.description: An older British woman in her late sixties, a cheerful practical farmer and gardener. Warm, down-to-earth and matter-of-fact, with a naturally mature female voice, a little soft age texture and a relaxed affectionate smile. Clear diction and an unhurried conversational pace. Confident but never stern; delighted by rain and growing things. Clean dry studio speech, no music or effects.

lindqvist.name: Mr. Lindqvist
lindqvist.appearance: Silver-haired older man with spectacles, bow tie and formal waistcoat.
lindqvist.direction: Older male, precise but warm, with understated amusement.
lindqvist.description: An elderly British man in his late sixties, a precise gentle piano teacher with spectacles and a bow tie. A warm clear light baritone voice with subtle natural age texture. Careful diction, musical phrasing and quietly amused kindness; dignified but secretly playful. Unhurried conversation, never a stern lecture or grand announcer voice. Clean dry studio speech, no music or effects.
